title: Admin bootstrap/promotion gating and Admin Panel Results + Accuracy UI

requirements.summary: Implement safe admin bootstrap/promotion UI and role-based gating so the Admin Panel is visible only to admins, with a one-time first-admin bootstrap when no admins exist.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user is admin, the PrimaryNav shows the 'Admin' link and '/admin' renders the Admin Panel instead of AccessDeniedScreen.
When a user is not admin, the 'Admin' link is not shown and navigating to '/admin' shows AccessDeniedScreen.

A newly deployed canister with zero admins supports a one-time bootstrap flow that allows the first authenticated user to become admin (subsequent users cannot use the bootstrap flow once an admin exists).
If an admin already exists, only an existing admin can promote another principal to admin.
The frontend refreshes the cached current user role after the admin role is granted (Admin link appears without requiring a hard reload).

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for admin bootstrap/promotion and admin-gating checks (e.g., call backend capabilities like bootstrapAdmin(), promoteToAdmin(), isAdminPanelVisible()); on success, invalidate ['currentUserRole'] so admin state updates without reload. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend the admin guard to support a one-time bootstrap path: when user is authenticated but not admin, query whether bootstrap is available (via backend capability) and render a bootstrap screen; otherwise render existing AccessDeniedScreen. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a bootstrap UI shown only when no admins exist: explain that the first authenticated user can become admin, provide a single-action button to call bootstrapAdmin(), and show English success/error messaging; on success, trigger role refetch (query invalidation) so PrimaryNav updates. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an admin-only 'Promote to Admin' section (e.g., under an existing tab) that allows an admin to input a Principal text and call promoteToAdmin(); show English success/error toasts and invalidate ['currentUserRole'] after promotion. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure current-user role caching/refresh behavior is compatible with post-mutation invalidation (e.g., keep queryKey stable and avoid role being stuck as guest after bootstrap/promotion). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm admin link visibility reacts to live role changes (no hard reload) by relying on useCurrentUser() role query; no new routes added. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add Admin Panel UI for updating ticket results and tracking accuracy using backend Results data, and update ResultsPage to read consistent backend results rather than client-only assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend has a Results data structure stored in-canister and admin-only mutation(s) to record/update a ticket’s result (e.g., win/loss) and completion time, keyed by ticket id.
Non-admin callers cannot create/update results and receive an authorization failure.
Frontend Admin Panel includes a usable UI to set a ticket result (Win/Loss) for an existing ticket and submit it successfully.
Frontend Admin Panel includes a 'Track Accuracy' view that shows accuracy metrics computed from stored results (at minimum: total decided tickets, wins, losses, win rate %).
Admin Panel success/error toasts are shown in English for results updates and accuracy actions.

ResultsPage continues to function; if it relies on results data, it must read from the backend Results source (or remain consistent with stored results) rather than requiring manual client-only assumptions.

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks to read results and accuracy and to update results (e.g., getAllResultsWithTickets(), calculateAccuracy(), updateTicketResult()); include admin-friendly error handling so authorization traps show as English toast errors in the UI layer. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace the Accuracy placeholder with a working 'Track Accuracy' view that reads backend results and displays total decided, wins, losses, and win rate %. Add an 'Update Results' UI (within Admin Panel, e.g., in Accuracy tab or a new Results tab) allowing admins to select an existing ticket id and set result to Win/Loss, then submit via updateTicketResult(); show English success/error toasts. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Refactor the Results dashboard to compute metrics from backend results data (e.g., getAllResultsWithTickets()) and keep the Recent Results list consistent with stored results; if ticket details are still displayed, merge ticket metadata with results statuses rather than trusting client-only ticket.status. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
